notes_for_editor: Very thin. The Forest Lookouts page for Potato Knob has only a heading and the county; the record's kind 'tower' rests on that listing alone. Two searches returned only summit, map and peak pages (MountainZone, AnyPlaceAmerica, PeakVisor, Mapcarta), none describing a tower or lookout. The NHLR Kentucky list (17 lookouts) and the FFLOS Kentucky list (8 former sites) were checked and do not name Potato Knob. The story is about 70 words, below the usual 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin. Suggest human review before publishing; a local source such as a Carter County history or Kentucky Forest Service record would be needed to say anything about the structure.
